title: Console design systems onboarding kit and accessibility checklist
creator: Ava Campbell
description: Create an onboarding kit and governance artifacts to accelerate adoption of the Console Figma library and ensure accessibility parity across dashboards, rollouts, and cost views. Deliverables: trimmed starter Figma file, token mapping spreadsheet, variant governance doc, accessibility checklist (WCAG 2.1 AA), migration guide for older components, and a 60-minute training workshop + recording.
acceptance_criteria: Starter Figma kit published to team library with clear usage README
Token mapping spreadsheet maps all color/spacing/type tokens used in top 8 console views
Variant governance doc defines when to create new variants vs. compose existing ones
Accessibility checklist covers keyboard focus, color contrast, and screen reader labels with examples
Migration guide includes two example refactors and a PR template for engineers
Workshop run and recording posted to Drive; attendance by at least 6 cross-functional engineers/PMs
tasks: Inventory existing console components across dashboards, rollout panels, and cost views
Extract token usage and generate canonical token mapping (colors, type scale, spacing)
Draft variant governance doc and circulate for feedback
Create accessibility checklist with code/HTML examples and link to Axe tests
Assemble starter Figma kit and publish to team library
Author migration guide and example PRs in repo
Schedule and run adoption workshop; record session
